name: jira-ticket-search
description: Search Jira tickets using a query.
script:
set -e
items=$(acli jira workitem search --jql "$PECORE_PARAMS_QUERY" --fields key,summary --paginate --json | jq -e '(if type == "array" then . else .issues end) | map({id: .key, title: (.fields.summary // .summary)})')
printf '%s\n' "$items" | jq -e '{title: "Tickets", body: tojson}'
